about: #3812: the names the mainframe seed's rename transform rewrites, each with its language's length limit. Every channel is named from one: units (PGMA, PROCA, ASMA, STEPA), calls and their targets (PGMA/PGMB/PGMC, PROCA), the include (INCA), CICS and CSD files (FILEA), the CSD group and transaction (GRPA, TRNA: a TRANSID is 4 bytes), dataset qualifiers (CUSTA, YEARA: 8 each) and PL/I items (AMOUNTA, YEARA, CODEA).
